address: 22 rue de la Fontaine, Vannes, 56000, France
bio: In the heart of the city, a couple of young industry professionals have set up this restaurant with a warm, elegant decor that has been thought out down to the last detail (eg mosaics, tapestries inspired by drawings of the chef's dishes, and bespoke furniture). Cuttlefish ravioli, Noilly Prat, wild garlic and morels; turbot, peas and an astonishing koji yoghurt sauce: chef Alexandre Juton also draws inspiration from the season to concoct appealing dishes that are testament to his culinary expertise and experience in renowned establishments....
